challenges.challenge_description: Simmotion (fan-voted challenge); Aubry's first individual immunity win of the season

notable_events: Aubry wins final immunity (Simmotion, fan-voted challenge); her first individual immunity win this season
Aubry takes Joe to Final 3; puts Jonathan and Rizo in fire-making
Jonathan defeats Rizo at fire-making; both had lost fire on their prior seasons
Rizo breaks down before fire; Joe coaches him through it
AUBRY BRACCO WINS SURVIVOR 50: 8-3-0 over Jonathan Young and Joe Hunter
Aubry wins $2 million (record-tying prize, matching S40 Winners at War)
Aubry's redemption arc: previously competed on S32 Kaoh Rong (lost to Michele) and S34 Game Changers
Jeff Probst accidentally spoiled the fire-making result during the live broadcast
Cirie Fields wins $100,000 Sia Fan Favorite prize
Season 51 'The Open Era' announced: every twist from Survivor history returns
S50 averaged nearly 10M viewers after 35 days streaming; most-watched reality series of 2025-26
